summary: Reworked both complete guides/quizzes with separate NLB/DNS architectures, constrained proposal/opt-in failover, reliable manual changes, valid data placement and explicit lifecycle/availability limits.
findings: Blue/green is not equivalent to single-AZ workers; shared dependencies and rollback timing do not guarantee zero downtime/cost or instant isolation. Align with corrected ops01/15.

KO NLB cross-zone=false contradicts target groups confined to different AZs and global weight shifting; no SG at NLB creation; explicit target-group names conflict with create_before_destroy; TCP80 forwarding to TLS443 is not HTTPS redirect.

Weights are integer0..999 relative values; sum100 not required. KO file(ERROR) validation misuse, EN tfvars repeats same keys four times. Routine -target and -auto-approve pathways need reviewable full plans and validated bounds.
Manual static Pod-IP attachments drift and can conflict with controller ownership; use separate TGB per cluster/service with prereqs/ports/TLS explicit.

DNS weighted/failover records point to the SAME NLB so do not select clusters; KO names differ so not even one weighted record group. Per-color health names also resolve shared NLB; need distinct real endpoints as a separate design. TTL is not recovery SLA.
State names/keys/provider versions incomplete; align account-qualified backend with ops01. EN failover folder references NLB resources from another root; backend configuration missing.

Postgres examples lack required password/bootstrap/Service and KO PGDATA subdir; EN PVC StorageClass name mismatch. AutoMode uses ebs.csi.eks.amazonaws.com. Redis affinity namespace/zone-vs-node wording, fake myapp image, Kafka7.5 ZooKeeper/nonnumeric brokerID/incomplete listeners misleading.
NodePool requirements vs NodeClass subnet selectors and Pod nodeSelector semantics; missing tolerations/selection for dedicated database pool; spread constraints cannot create missing domains.

Lambda event envelopes mismatch direct CloudWatch/SNS; both action paths cause duplicate/invalid invocation. EN handler index.handler vs zip failover.py; listener ARN contains no port, so wrong HTTP/TLS TG mapping.

KO no destination-health check; EN checks onlyHTTPthenchangesboth. Both lack event freshness/idempotency/cooldown/single-writer/capacity guard. Health alarms can flap or miss empty/no-data target sets.

Notification publishes into alarm input SNS topic (extra erroneous deliveries); separate channels. Missing hashes/packaging/source for scheduled health_check function; EN missing Lambda resource. IAMModifyListener/logs too broad.

Manual scripts permit arithmetic expression injection/negative or zero steps, assumeinitial100/0, defaulttargetgreen, ignoreactual state/SLO and partiallymutate multiplelisteners. Need validated exact maps and negative tests.
validation: Two actual AWS6.64 Terraform schemas pass;6NLB+3DNS mock-provider cases pass.
25 Python fake-client cases checked against actual botocore input models;12 manual fake-CLI cases pass.
4 core Kubernetes objects and TGB CRD validated; Pod/NodePool label/taint/zone/service/PVC references checked.
Lambda ZIP entrypoint+vendored dependencies+CRC+source identity checked;all Bash/Python fences parse;sharedHCLmatchesfixtures.
Four source/quiz pages local-link/H1 checks pass;2diagrams9/9+4viewport/themechecks+actualscreenshotsinspected+PNGsdecoded.
